title: Bounded FIFO Queue
prompt: Given: mutex, condvar, `int slots[8]`, head/tail/count. Implement `int qpush(int v)` (append FIFO; -1 when full) and `int qpop(void)` (remove oldest; -1 when empty). Push/pop must maintain the mutex and the invariant count equals live elements.

tests.name: FIFO order
tests.hint: Oldest in, first out: the queue is a ring, not a stack.

tests.name: empty pop refused
tests.hint: Popping an empty queue is refused, not garbage.

tests.name: fill then refuse, drain then refuse
tests.hint: Eight slots exactly: the ninth push is refused, and a full drain leaves the queue empty.
